name: smwgraphics-demon-s-crest-atlantis-surface
title: Demon's Crest - Atlantis (Surface)
description:
The lakeside background seen in the fifth stage of Demon's Crest. Compared to Hadron's version, my version is faithful to the original game and has no glaring cutoffs. A good fit for lake or mountain levels, in general.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
